db_secret_arn.description: Pass this to the application so it can read DB credentials from Secrets Manager

security_group_id.description: ID of the app security group — pass to database module to allow DB access

ami_id.description: AMI ID. Use the latest Amazon Linux 2023 or Ubuntu 22.04 LTS.

iam_instance_profile.description: IAM instance profile name for SSM access. Must include AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore.

ingress_rules.description:
List of ingress rules to allow. Only define what you need.
Example: [{ description = "HTTP from LB", from_port = 80, to_port = 80, protocol = "tcp", cidr_blocks = [], security_groups = ["sg-123"] }]

instance_type.description: EC2 instance type. OPA policy enforces the allowed list.

root_volume_size_gb.description: Root EBS volume size in GB

subnet_id.description: Subnet ID for the instance. Use a private subnet.

tags.description: Tags to apply to all resources

user_data.description: EC2 user data script. Runs as root on first boot — use it to set up a non-root service user.

vpc_id.description: VPC ID to place the instance in

secret_arn.description: ARN of the Secrets Manager secret containing DB credentials. Pass to application IAM policy.

description.constant_value: Database security group - accepts connections from app tier only

app_security_group_id.description: Security group ID of the app tier. Only this SG can reach port 5432.

backup_retention_days.description: Number of days to retain automated backups. Minimum 7 for production.

db_name.description: Name of the database to create

db_username.description: Master username for the RDS instance

deletion_protection.description: Prevent the database from being deleted. Always true in prod.

multi_az.description: Enable Multi-AZ deployment. Always true in prod.

private_subnet_ids.description: List of private subnet IDs for the DB subnet group. Requires at least 2 (different AZs).

tags.description: Tags to apply to all resources

availability_zones.description: List of AZs to deploy subnets into. Must have at least 2 for RDS.

name.description: Name prefix for all resources in this network

nat_gateway_enabled.description: Whether to provision a NAT gateway for private subnets. Disable in dev to reduce cost.

tags.description: Tags to apply to all resources. Must include Owner and CostCenter.

presigned_url_policy_arn.description: IAM policy ARN for pre-signed URL generation. Attach to application role.

noncurrent_version_expiry_days.description: Days to retain non-current object versions before deletion

purpose.description: Bucket purpose suffix (e.g. uploads, backups, logs)

tags.description: Tags to apply to all resources

ami_id.description: AMI ID for EC2 instances. Use latest Amazon Linux 2023.

owner.description: Team or person responsible for this environment
